l-e-h2-b04-18.material: Waxaad qortaa 5 weedhood oo rogid ah maalintii oo aad tababartaa maalin kasta 3 toddobaad (21 maalmood). Qiyaas qiyaastii imisa weedhood ayaad qori doontaa wadar ahaan.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.r.a: 5 maalintii waa qiyaastii qiimaha 3 maalmood, ma aha qiimaha 21 maalmood.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.r.b: Taasi waa qiyaastii qiimaha hal toddobaad. 3 toddobaad way ka badan yihiin.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.r.d: 5 maalintii 21 maalmood aad bay uga yar yihiin 1000.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s1.explain: Sagootiyidda 21 ilaa 20, 5×20=100. Qiyaastii 100 weedhood ayaa si sax ah ku habboon.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s2.model.0: Sagootiyidda 21 maalmood ilaa 20 maalmood, 5×20=100, sidaa darteed waa qiyaastii 100 weedhood.
l-e-h2-b04-18.s.s2.model.1: Leh 5 maalintii 3 toddobaad, waxaad qortaa 5 weedhood 21 jeer, sidaa darteed waa agagaarka 100.

l-e-h2-b04-19.title: 12 weedhood oo wish ah: ma waqti ku filan ayaa jiri doona?
l-e-h2-b04-19.topic: Waqtiga loo baahan yahay shaqada guriga
l-e-h2-b04-19.goal: Qiyaas waqtiga ay qaadanayso saxidda dhammaan weedhaha wish si aad u go'aamiso cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababtaada.
l-e-h2-b04-19.material: Shaqada gurigu waa dib u qorista 12 weedhood adigoo isticmaalaya wish, waxaadna haysataa 30 daqiiqo. Saxidda 3-dii ugu horreysay waxay qaadatay 6 daqiiqo. Qiyaas intee ayay qaadan doontaa haddii aad ilaaliso isla xawaaraha.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.prompt: Intee ayay qaadan doontaa saxidda dhammaan 12?
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.r.a: 6 daqiiqo 3 macnaheedu waa 2 daqiiqo 1, sidaa darteed 12 daqiiqo aad bay u gaaban yihiin.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.r.c: 12 waa 4 jeer 3, sidaa darteed waa 24 daqiiqo. 36 daqiiqo aad bay u dheer yihiin.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad tirada weedhaha ku dhuftay 6 daqiiqo, sidaa darteed qiyaastaadu aad bay u weyn tahay.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s1.explain: 6 daqiiqo 3 macnaheedu waa 2 daqiiqo 1. 12 weedhood waxay qaadanayaan qiyaastii 24 daqiiqo, sidaa darteed waad dhammayn kartaa 30 daqiiqo gudahood.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s2.model.0: Waxay qaadataa 2 daqiiqo 1 waxaana jira 12, sidaa darteed waxay qaadataa 24 daqiiqo oo waad dhammayn kartaa 30 daqiiqo gudahood.
l-e-h2-b04-19.s.s2.model.1: 12 waa 4 jeer 3, 4 jeer 6 daqiiqo na waa 24 daqiiqo, sidaa darteed waqti yari ma jirto.

l-e-h2-b04-20.goal: Qiyaas tirada weedhaha -ever ee qoraal ku jira si aad u go'aamiso cabbir ama xad ku habboon, oo sharax sababtaada.
l-e-h2-b04-20.material: Qoraal 90 erey ah, weedh -ever ah sida whenever ama whoever ayaa celcelis ahaan ka muuqata hal mar 18 erey kasta. Qiyaas qiyaastii imisa weedh -ever ah ayaa qoraalkan ku jira.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.prompt: Qiyaastii imisa weedh -ever ah ayaa jira?
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.r.a: Haddii hal ay jirto 18 erey kasta, waxaa jira in ka badan hal 90 erey gudahood.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.r.c: 18 waa farqiga u dhexeeya erayada, ma aha tirada.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.r.d: 90 waa tirada ereyada. Macnaheedu maaha hal erey kasta.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s1.explain: 90 loo qaybiyay 18 waa 5. Hal 18 erey kasta, waxaa jira qiyaastii 5.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s2.model.0: Maadaama 90÷18=5, waxaa jira qiyaastii 5 weedhood -ever ah.
l-e-h2-b04-20.s.s2.model.1: Hal ayaa ka muuqda 18 erey kasta, sidaa darteed 18 wuxuu galaa 90 5 jeer, taasoo macnaheedu yahay qiyaastii 5.

l-e-h2-b05-19.title: Intee la mid ah suurtagalnimada wax leh "were to"?
l-e-h2-b05-19.goal: Qiyaas suurtagalnimada "were to" muujiyo, go'aami cabbir ama heer ku habboon, oo sharax sababtaada.
l-e-h2-b05-19.material: Qof ayaa yidhi, 'If the train were to arrive early, we would catch the 9:00 bus.' Qiyaas intee la mid ah ayuu hadlaha u malaynayaa inuu tareenku goor hore yimaado.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.r.a: Haddii ay ahaan lahayd fifty-fifty, "were to" ma isticmaali lahayd.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.r.b: Haddii ay ahaan lahayd mid ku dhow hubaal, waxaad odhan lahayd "If the train arrives early".
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.r.c: Haddii ay hubaal ahaan lahayd, ma male-awaali lahayd laakiin waxaad ku odhan lahayd "will".
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s1.explain: "If ... were to ..." waa male-awaal loo arko mid aad u yar suurtagalnimo. Wuxuu ku habboon yahay dhacdooyin dhif ah sida ku dhawaad 5%.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s2.model.0: "were to" wuxuu male-awaalaa wax aan dhif ahayn dhici doonin, sidaas darteed in loo arko ku dhawaad 5% waa mid ku habboon.
l-e-h2-b05-19.s.s2.model.1: Haddii wax u badan yihiin inay dhacaan, waxaad isticmaashaa waqtiga hadda, sidaas darteed weedh leh "were to" waxay muujisaa in hadlaha u arko mid aan u badnayn.
